details.effect: [fanfare] Put a Repair Mode token into your EX area. Then, if there are at least 3 cards named Repair Mode in your EX area, draw a card. Whenever you play a Repair Mode, select a follower on your field and give it Bane.

issues: The 'Whenever you play a Repair Mode' ability is encoded incorrectly. Replace the current onCardPlayed/grantOnCardPlayed structure with a direct triggered ability that triggers when you play a card named Repair Mode and grants Bane to a selected follower on your field.

The triggered ability to grant Bane is missing the actual target-selection form from the source. It should target a follower on your field (for example with targets.type 'selfFollower' or 'anyFollower' as appropriate to your controller-only field targeting), not wrap the effect as a granted future trigger.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost02]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] Put a Repair Mode token into your EX area. If this card was put onto the field by an ability, evolve it.

issues: The second fanfare ability is encoded with the wrong effect. If this card was put onto the field by an ability, it should evolve itself; replace evolveOtherFollower excludeSelf:true with an effect that evolves this follower.
